description: Independent-evidence corroboration record (oev-corroboration/0.1, V3-C18). A trusted external source attests values about bundle content in a different trust domain from the producer/witness keys. content_digest is the SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical claims object (sha256:<64 hex>); the verifier recomputes it and compares the claims against values recomputed from the bundle. The DSSE envelope (Ed25519 over the PAE of the JCS-canonical record) is verified against a caller-supplied trust root; the envelope keyid is an unauthenticated hint only.

claims.description: Values the source stands behind (profile-specific: e.g. financial amount_minor/invoice_no, dataset sha256/rows_declared, ai-eval mae/rmse/r2).

content_digest.description: SHA-256 of the JCS-canonical claims object.

issued_at.description: When the source issued this record (strict YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ claimed time; used for source-key validity checks when present).

source_id.description: Identity of the external source (e.g. an ERP system, dataset registry, or independent evaluation harness).

source_key_id.description: Key id of the source's signing key (unauthenticated hint; the verifier matches the key cryptographically against the trust root).

timestamp_ref.description: Optional timestamp reference for the record (e.g. an RFC 3161 token digest held elsewhere). The verifier records it; it does not prove wall-clock time by itself.

trust_root_id.description: Identifier of the trust root under which the source key is trusted; the caller must supply this root.

title: OEVP Corroboration Record
